headline: Approved $2,425,000 for the Board of Education and $991,338 for a Supplemental Municipal Assistance Grant, plus routine budget transfers.
summary: The meeting approved a series of budget transfers and appropriations, including the Consent Calendar items. It approved $2,425,000 for the Board of Education after a $70,000 reduction from the amount first presented. It also approved a $2,475,081 transfer to close out fiscal year 2025-2026 and $1,253,585 in General Fund carryovers.
decisions: Approved $61,999 in transfers within the Special Grants & Donations Fund for the Shine Early Learning allocation, unanimously.
Approved an additional appropriation of $58,900 within the Library's operating budget, funded by trust funds, unanimously.
Approved an additional appropriation of $2,000 within the Special Grants & Donations Fund for program supplies, unanimously.
Approved an additional appropriation totaling $21,634 within the Special Grants & Donations Fund, funded by Code Enforcement revenue, unanimously.
Approved transfers totaling $167,975 within the General Fund and an additional appropriation of $7,650 within the Community Development Block Grant for contract settlements, unanimously.
Approved an additional appropriation of $22,089 within the Public Works operating budget, unanimously.
Approved an additional appropriation of $40,042 within the Public Works operating budget for Perm Patch, unanimously.
Approved an additional appropriation of $260,548 within the Parks operating budget, funded by Trust revenue, unanimously.
Approved an additional appropriation of $290,940 within the Special Grants & Donations Fund, funded by program revenues, unanimously.
Approved transfers totaling $30,000 within the Special Grants & Donations Fund for Parks, Recreation, Youth & Community Services, unanimously.
Approved an additional appropriation of $95,151 within the Equipment Building Sinking Fund, funded by interest income, unanimously.
Approved an additional appropriation of $248,921 within the Capital Projects Fund, funded by interest income, unanimously.
Approved an additional appropriation of $87,034 within the Capital Non-Recurring Fund, funded by interest income, unanimously.
Approved an additional appropriation of $49,581 within the Road Improvements Fund, funded by interest income, unanimously.

Approved a transfer of $5,849 from the General Fund Contingency Account and an additional appropriation of $11,698 within the Special Grants and Donations Fund for the 2025 Bulletproof Vest Partnership Program, unanimously.
Approved transfers totaling $2,475,081 within the General Fund to close out fiscal year 2025-2026, unanimously.
Approved carryovers totaling $1,253,585 within the General Fund from fiscal year 2025-2026 to fiscal year 2026-2027, unanimously.
Approved carryovers totaling $7,855 within the Community Development Block Grant Fund from fiscal year 2025-2026 to fiscal year 2026-2027, unanimously.
Approved an additional appropriation of $2,425,000 within the General Fund for the Board of Education, after reducing the amount from $2,495,000, unanimously.
Approved a transfer of $59,800 from the EBSF Contingency account to purchase Kronos timeclocks, unanimously.
Approved an additional appropriation of $991,338 within the General Fund for the Supplemental Municipal Assistance Grant, unanimously.

441 
September 8, 2026 
 
 
The Joint Meeting of the City Council and Board of Finance was held on September 8, 2026 
in the City Hall Council Chambers, 111 North Main Street at 6:45 p.m. Present: Mayor Zoppo-Sassu; 
Council Members Dickau, Hahn, Kelley, Seymour and Tyler; Commissioners Campion, Mace, 
Maikowski, Murdock and O’Brien. Present by Videoconference: Council Member Rosengren; 
Commissioners Tagariello and Massarelli. Absent: Commissioner Peterson. 
 
1. APPROVAL OF MINUTES. 
 
On motion of Council Member Dickau and seconded, it was unanimously voted: To approve 
the minutes of the regular Joint Meeting held on August 12, 2026. 
  
2. ADOPTION OF CONSENT CALENDAR.   
 
On motion of Council Member Dickau and seconded, it was unanimously voted: To adopt the 
following fourteen items as part of the Consent Calendar. 
 
3. $61,999 TRANSFER WITHIN SPECIAL GRANTS & DONATIONS FUND FOR 
SHINE EARLY LEARNING ALLOCATION, APPROVED. 
 
Board of Finance approval presented. 
 
As part of the Consent Calendar adoption and on motion of Council Member Dickau and 
seconded, it was unanimously voted: To make transfers totaling $61,999 within the Special Grants & 
Donations Fund for the Shine Early Learning allocation. 
 
4. $58,900 ADDITIONAL APPROPRIATION WITHIN LIBRARY’S OPERATING 
BUDGET FUNDED BY TRUST FUNDS, APPROVED.  
 
Board of Finance approval presented.  
 
As part of the Consent Calendar adoption and on motion of Council Member Dickau and 
seconded, it was unanimously voted: To make an additional appropriation of $58,900 within the 
Library's operating budget funded by trust funds. 
 
5. $2,000 ADDITIONAL APPROPRIATION WITHIN SPECIAL GRANTS & 
DONATIONS FUND FOR PROGRAM SUPPLIES, APPROVED.  
 
Board of Finance approval presented.  
 
As part of the Consent Calendar adoption and on motion of Council Member Dickau and 
seconded, it was unanimously voted: To make an additional appropriation of $2,000 within the 
Special Grants & Donations Fund for program supplies.
442  
September 8, 2026 
 
6. $21,634 ADDITIONAL APPROPRIATION WITHIN SPECIAL GRANTS & 
DONATIONS FUND AS OF JUNE 30,2026 FUNDED BY CODE ENFORCEMENT 
REVENUE, APPROVED.  
 
Board of Finance approval presented.  
 
As part of the Consent Calendar adoption and on motion of Council Member Dickau and 
seconded, it was unanimously voted: To make an additional appropriation totaling $21,634 within the 
Special Grants & Donations Fund as of June 30, 2026 funded by Code Enforcement revenue. 
 
7. $167,975 TRANSFER WITHIN GENERAL FUND AND $7,650 ADDITIONAL 
APPROPRIATION WITHIN COMMUNITY DEVELOPMENT BLOCK GRANT 
FOR CONTRACT SETTLEMENTS, APPROVED.  
 
Board of Finance approval presented.  
 
As part of the Consent Calendar adoption and on motion of Council Member Dickau and 
seconded, it was unanimously voted: To make transfers totaling $167,975 within the General Fund 
and an additional appropriation of $7,650 within the Community Development Block Grant for 
contract settlements. 
 
8. $22,089 ADDITIONAL APPROPRIATION WITHIN PUBLIC WORKS OPERATING 
BUDGET AS OF JUNE 30, 2026, APPROVED.  
 
Board of Finance approval presented.  
 
As part of the Consent Calendar adoption and on motion of Council Member Dickau and 
seconded, it was unanimously voted: To make an additional appropriation of $22,089 within the PW 
operating budget as of June 30, 2026. 
 
9. $40,042 ADDITIONAL APPROPRIATION WITHIN PUBLIC WORKS OPERATING 
BUDGET AS OF JUNE 30, 2026 FOR PERM PATCH, APPROVED.  
 
Board of Finance approval presented.  
 
As part of the Consent Calendar adoption and on motion of Council Member Dickau and 
seconded, it was unanimously voted: To make an additional appropriation of $40,042 within the PW 
operating budget as of June 30, 2026 for Perm Patch. 
 
10. $260,548 ADDITIONAL APPROPRIATION WITHIN PARKS OPERATING 
BUDGET AS OF JUNE 30, 2026 FUNDED BY TRUST REVENUE, APPROVED.  
 
Board of Finance approval presented.  
 
As part of the Consent Calendar adoption and on motion of Council Member Dickau and 
seconded, it was unanimously voted: To make an additional appropriation of $260,548 within the 
Parks operating budget as of June 30, 2026 funded by Trust revenue.
443 
September 8, 2026 
 
11. $290,940 ADDITIONAL APPROPRIATION WITHIN SPECIAL GRANTS & 
DONATIONS FUND AS OF JUNE 30, 2026 FUNDED BY PROGRAM REVENUES, 
APPROVED.  
 
Board of Finance approval presented.  
 
As part of the Consent Calendar adoption and on motion of Council Member Dickau and 
seconded, it was unanimously voted: To make an additional appropriation of $290,940 within the 
Special Grants & Donations Fund as of June 30, 2026 funded by program revenues. 
 
12. $30,000 TRANSFER WITHIN SPECIAL GRANTS & DONATIONS FUND AS OF 
JUNE 30, 2026 FOR PARKS, RECREATION, YOUTH & COMMUNITY SERVICES, 
APPROVED.  
 
Board of Finance approval presented.  
 
As part of the Consent Calendar adoption and on motion of Council Member Dickau and 
seconded, it was unanimously voted: To make transfers totaling $30,000 within the Special Grants & 
Donations Fund as of June 30, 2026. 
 
13. $95,151 ADDITIONAL APPROPRIATION WITHIN EQUIPMENT BUILDING 
SINKING FUND AS OF JUNE 30, 2026 FUNDED BY INTEREST INCOME, 
APPROVED.  
 
Board of Finance approval presented.  
 
As part of the Consent Calendar adoption and on motion of Council Member Dickau and 
seconded, it was unanimously voted: To make an additional appropriation of $95,151 within the 
Equipment Building Sinking Fund as of June 30, 2026 funded by interest income. 
 
14. $248,921 ADDITIONAL APPROPRIATION WITHIN CAPITAL PROJECTS FUND 
AS OF JUNE 30, 2026 FUNDED BY INTEREST INCOME, APPROVED.  
 
Board of Finance approval presented.  
 
As part of the Consent Calendar adoption and on motion of Council Member Dickau and 
seconded, it was unanimously voted: To make an additional appropriation of $248,921 within the 
Capital Projects Fund as of June 30, 2026 funded by interest income. 
 
15. $87,034 ADDITIONAL APPROPRIATION WITHIN CAPITAL NON-RECURRING 
FUND AS OF JUNE 30, 2026 FUNDED BY INTEREST INCOME, APPROVED.  
 
Board of Finance approval presented.  
 
As part of the Consent Calendar adoption and on motion of Council Member Dickau and 
seconded, it was unanimously voted: To make an additional appropriation of $87,034 within the 
Capital Non-Recurring Fund as of June 30, 2026 funded by interest income.
444  
September 8, 2026 
 
16. $49,581 ADDITIONAL APPROPRIATION WITHIN ROAD IMPROVEMENTS 
FUND AS OF JUNE 30, 2026 FUNDED BY INTEREST INCOME, APPROVED.  
 
Board of Finance approval presented.  
 
As part of the Consent Calendar adoption and on motion of Council Member Dickau and 
seconded, it was unanimously voted: To make an additional appropriation of $49,581 within the Road 
Improvements Fund as of June 30, 2026 funded by interest income. 
 
17. $5,849 TRANSFER FROM GENERAL FUND CONTINGENCY ACCOUNT AND 
$11,698 ADDITIONAL APPROPRIATION WITHIN SPECIAL GRANTS & 
DONATIONS FUND FOR 2025 BULLETPROOF VEST PARTNERSHIP PROGRAM, 
APPROVED.  
 
Board of Finance approval presented.  
 
On motion of Council Member Hahn and seconded, it was unanimously voted: To transfer 
$5,849 from the General Fund Contingency Account and make an additional appropriation of $11,698 
within the Special Grants and Donations Fund for the 2025 Bulletproof Vest Partnership Program.  
 
18. $2,475,081 TRANSFER WITHIN GENERAL FUND TO CLOSEOUT FISCAL YEAR 
2025-2026, APPROVED.  
 
Board of Finance approval presented.  
 
On motion of Council Member Seymour and seconded, it was unanimously voted: To 
approve transfers totaling $2,475,081 within the General Fund to closeout fiscal year 2025-2026. 
 
19. $1,253,585 CARRYOVERS WITHIN GENERAL FUND FROM FISCAL YEAR 2025-
2026 TO FISCAL YEAR 2026-2027, APPROVED.  
 
Board of Finance approval presented.  
 
On motion of Council Member Dickau and seconded, it was unanimously voted: To approve 
Carryovers totaling $1,253,585 within the General Fund from fiscal year 2025-2026 to fiscal year 
2026-2027. 
 
20. $7,855 CARRYOVERS WITHIN COMMUNITY DEVELOPMENT BLOCK GRANT 
FUND FROM FISCAL YEAR 2025-2026 TO FISCAL YEAR 2026-2027, APPROVED.  
 
Board of Finance approval presented.  
 
On motion of Council Member Seymour and seconded, it was unanimously voted: To 
approve Carryovers totaling $7,855 within the Community Development Block Grant Fund from 
fiscal year 2025-2026 to fiscal year 2026-2027.
445 
September 8, 2026 
 
21. $2,425,000 ADDITIONAL APPROPRIATION WITHIN GENERAL FUND AS OF 
JUNE 30, 2026 FOR BOARD OF EDUCATION, APPROVED.  
 
On motion of Council Member Tyler and seconded, it was unanimously voted: To amend the 
amount originally presented due to an adjustment to the Board of Education expenditures, therefore 
modifying the appropriation from $2,495,000 to $2,425,000, a reduction of $70,000. 
 
Board of Finance approval presented.  
 
On motion of Council Member Seymour and seconded, it was unanimously voted: To make 
an additional appropriation of $2,425,000 within the General Fund as of June 30, 2026 for the Board 
of Education. 
 
22. $59,800 TRANSFER FROM EBSF CONTINGENCY ACCOUNT TO PURCHASE 
KRONOS TIMECLOCKS, APPROVED.  
 
Board of Finance approval presented.  
 
On motion of Council Member Seymour and seconded, it was unanimously voted: To 
transfer $59,800 from the EBSF Contingency account to purchase timeclocks. 
 
23. $991,338 ADDITIONAL APPROPRIATIONWITHIN GENERAL FUND FOR 
SUPPLEMENTAL MUNICIPAL ASSISTANCE GRANT, APPROVED.  
 
Board of Finance approval presented.  
 
On motion of Council Member Hahn and seconded, it was unanimously voted: To make an 
additional appropriation of $991,338 within the General Fund for the Supplemental Municipal 
Assistance Grant. 
 
24. MONTHLY REVENUE AND EXPENSE REPORT PRESENTATION BY 
COMPTROLLER. 
 
Comptroller Waldron highlighted a monthly revenue and expense report for the Joint Meeting 
members.  
 
25. ADJOURNMENT. 
 
 At 6:56 p.m., on motion of Council Member Seymour and seconded, it was unanimously 
voted: To adjourn. 
 
 
ATTEST: ___________________________________ 
                 Erica Cabiya 
                 Town & City Clerk
